text:
Ava (CSM): Day-0 sync scheduled with Cobalt Labs tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: VPC connectivity (endpoints/peering), IAM cross-account roles, KMS CMK ownership & rotation, audit-log sink + retention. Can everyone confirm availability and any pre-reads? @Devon @Ravi @Maya

Devon (Solutions Eng): I can do 10am. I'll bring a simple VPC diagram and an examples doc for interface endpoints + route table snippets. Also want to confirm whether they use Transit Gateway or simple peering.

Ravi (Infra Eng): I'll lead KMS/rotation discussion. Quick question: Cobalt mentioned "customer-managed CMK with 30-day rotation" — do we have a standard rotation cadence requirement in the runbook or do we treat this as a customer policy override?

Maya (Solutions Eng): We support both. For customer-managed CMK we need: KMS Key ARN, key policy that grants our service principal and the cross-account role appropriate permissions, and an Allow on kms:DescribeKey for diagnostics. Example minimal policy we usually share:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWOOD-ACCOUNT:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Replace REDFWOOD-ACCOUNT with our account id; we'll provide the exact ARN after the meeting. Also note: if they want automatic rotation every 30 days we recommend an automated Lambda rotation plan; I'll bring our template.

ops-bot: Please remember to attach the onboarding runbook: https://redwood.example/onboarding/runbooks/private-vpc (read-only).

Devon (Solutions Eng): Network checklist items we need from Cobalt pre-meeting: list of subnets for private endpoints, route table IDs for the subnets, NACLs that might block ephemeral egress, and any proxy/egress gateway IPs. We also need the outbound IP ranges we’ll use for health checks and SIEM webhook: 52.12.34.56/32 and 3.23.45.0/24 (temporary, will confirm).

Ravi (Infra Eng): Audit logs: they asked for 90-day retention in their S3 with CloudTrail + config aggregator. Need to confirm whether they want S3 SSE-KMS using the same CMK or a separate S3-only CMK. Also ask if they require MFA-delete on the bucket.

Jordan (Cobalt): We prefer SSE-KMS with our CMK. I can share the ARNs and account ID during the call. Also would like an RBAC matrix for the IAM roles Redwood will assume (which role names, permissions boundaries).

Ava (CSM): Great — action items before the call: Maya to post a sanitized key-policy example in the calendar invite, Devon to attach VPC diagram and route snippet, Ravi to prepare KMS rotation options + recommended policy for 30d rotation, and Cobalt to share AWS account ID + bucket ARN. I'll resend the calendar invite with the pre-read checklist.

Devon (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: adding materials to the invite now.

calendar-bot: Calendar updated — meeting 10:00am PT tomorrow, invite sent to attendees.

Ava (CSM): If anything else pops up, drop it here. Otherwise we'll start the call with the VPC diagram and finish with a short cutover checklist and next-step dates. Thanks!
